summary: Public projects created on 25 July 2026: 8 repos.
intro: Agent tooling and reference material for coding and hardware work appeared across several repositories. These covered a system prompt that makes coding agents document their findings, a plugin for building unofficial MCP servers, an index of hardware build documentation, and a parametric 3D model set for warehouse storage units. Israeli tax and regulatory material also featured, alongside an urban environmental data API blueprint.

projects.name: Document As You Go
projects.description: A drop-in system prompt and slash command that make coding agents capture what they discover — undocumented APIs, auth flows, dead ends — instead of losing it when the session ends.

projects.name: Hardware Blueprints Index
projects.description: Index of repositories that document physical hardware builds — bills of materials, sourcing, wiring and enclosure specs, and firmware plans

projects.name: Israel Expense Classification Codes
projects.description: Israel Tax Authority Form 6111 business expense classification codes as machine-readable JSON, plus the separate income tax and VAT deduction rules. Unofficial.

projects.name: Israel Reference Repos
projects.description: Index of Israel-related reference material: standards, regulations, classification codes, datasets, directories and translated official guidance.

projects.name: Noisycity API Blueprint
projects.description: Blueprint for a public API for citizen-derived urban environmental data — noise, particulates and vibration from volunteer-operated monitoring stations. Planning repo; noisycity.org is a placeholder.

projects.name: Paperless Tax MCP
projects.description: Unofficial MCP server and API documentation for paperless.tax (Israeli bookkeeping SaaS) — community reverse-engineering effort

projects.name: Storage Box 3d Models
projects.description: Parametric GLB (glTF 2.0 binary) models of the standard industrial storage units you find in any warehouse, stockroom or workshop: euro stacking containers on the 600 × 400 mm module, an attached-lid...

projects.name: Unofficial MCP Builder Plugin
projects.description: Claude Code plugin for authoring and maintaining unofficial MCP servers for third-party APIs — generate from the vendor's docs (verified against the live API), detect upstream drift, and smoke-test...
